events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey walker scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l app/scripts/walk-scenarios.mjs app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs app/scripts/run-chain.sh; grep -n "finding\|jobs\|Kie\|kie\|process.env\|async function\|^const\|status ===\|waiting" app/scripts/walk-scenarios.mjs | head -80; git diff --stat app/scripts/run-chain.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey walk-ui and run-chain
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "jobs\|finding\|process.env\|async function\|function \|waiting\|running\|report\|writeFile" app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs | head -70; cat app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -79; git diff app/scripts/run-chain.sh

events.text: Polling fix is in walk-ui.mjs. Next I'll find out how to run the walkers locally (the centre plus the simulator).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read walker header, run-chain, listening ports
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,35p app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs | head -35; cat app/scripts/run-chain.sh; git diff app/scripts/run-chain.sh; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$9}' | sort -u | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check local stack health
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for p in 8790 8791 8792 8794 4361; do printf "$p "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/ ; done; ls -la /tmp/rc-local-admin-url; launchctl list | grep -i tantra; tail -5 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-200; ls /tmp/chain 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check for running chains and last summary
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; pgrep -fl "run-chain|walk-ui|probe-" | head; ls -la --time-style=+%H:%M /tmp/chain/summary.txt 2>/dev/null || stat -f "%Sm" /tmp/chain/summary.txt; cat /tmp/chain/summary.txt | head -30; date

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check admin URL and walker syntax
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; A=$(cat /tmp/rc-local-admin-url); curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" --max-time 5 "$A" | sed 's/k=[^&]*/k=***/'; node --check app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs && echo syntax ok

events.text: Stack is up. Running the full run-chain (which includes the three walkers) in the background.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run full chain with walkers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; bash app/scripts/run-chain.sh > /tmp/t242-chain.out 2>&1; echo EXIT $?; tail -30 /tmp/t242-chain.out

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for chain progress
events.input: $ for i in $(seq 1 19); do grep -q "chain summary" /tmp/t242-chain.out 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 30; done; cat /tmp/chain/summary.txt
